note: Marion County GA publishes its zoning only as a static JPG map (ZoningMap.jpg, 2019) and directs GIS requests to the Zoning Department. No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning polygons found for the county. The only 'Marion County' GIS open-data portal (gis-marioncounty.opendata.arcgis.com) is Marion County, Oregon. Buena Vista (the only incorporated city) publishes zoning only as ordinance text and a PDF/image map with no queryable service.
